retrievalProfile.description: A chaotic, hand-drawn urban party scene with airbrushed gradients and thick black outlines, featuring a cluttered living room after a celebration.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, cluttered interior scene depicting the aftermath of a party. The style uses heavy black ink outlines with airbrushed color fills and stippled shading. A long tan sofa sits centrally on a bright blue floor, surrounded by scattered bottles, glasses, and party debris. A fireplace and framed records decorate the back wall, while a large yellow banner hangs from the ceiling.
coreVisualRelationships: Central tan sofa as the primary horizontal anchor
Vibrant blue floor contrasting with warm yellow and tan walls
Chaotic distribution of small objects creating a sense of post-party mess
Curved banner and balloons adding vertical and diagonal movement to the upper half
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all objects
Stippled or dotted texture for shadows
Fisheye-adjacent perspective with slightly warped furniture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sofa is the central subject, scaled to occupy the middle third of the frame horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sofa and the large yellow banner above it act as the primary visual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the banner's curve from left to right, then drops to the cluttered floor, moving across the scattered items.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is intentionally dense and busy to convey chaos.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright cerulean blue (floor) and warm tan (furniture/walls).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black (outlines and fireplace) and bright yellow (banner).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and green (bottles, balloons, and small details).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with high-contrast values, using dark stippled shadows against bright mid-tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sans-serif with rounded terminals and variable stroke width
letterConstructionRules: Internal vertical color gradients (light to dark)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters on the banner are warped to follow the curve of the fabric
Main title text features a 'bulging' effect in the center of the strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine warped, banner-integrated lettering with a clean, high-contrast display font at the base.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the playful, thick-stroke energy of 90s cartoons.
The base skeleton of the banner text is a casual, rounded sans.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a messy living room after a party. Include a tan sofa on a bright blue floor, a fireplace with framed records, and a large yellow curved banner hanging from the ceiling. Use heavy black outlines and stippled shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase custom lettering with a blue-to-white vertical gradient and thick black outlines. Place the main title on a black bar at the bottom and warp secondary text to fit the yellow banner.

verificationChecks: Ensure black outlines are consistently thick
Check that shadows use a stippled/dotted texture
Verify the floor is a vibrant, saturated blue
Confirm the banner text follows the curve of the banner

adjustableVariables: Level of clutter on the floor
postGenerationChecks: Does the image look like a 90s hip-hop album cover?
Is the color palette dominated by blue, tan, and yellow?
Are the outlines heavy and hand-inked in appearance?
Is the text integrated into the scene's geometry (banner)?
recipe.reuseFormula: 90s Urban Illustration = (Heavy Ink Outlines + Airbrush Gradients + Stippled Shading) * Chaotic Interior Scene
